_about: The controlled keyword vocabulary: every value a document's keywords may hold (npm run validate fails on any other). One term per line, sorted with localeCompare (npm run config-sort and keywords-sync --write keep it that way). The rules that fold, drop and split source keywords onto these terms are in keywordDecisions.json; the hand-picked facet chips are docRendering.json facets. Read and written through src/main/lib/keywordConform.js (loadControlledKeywords / saveControlledKeywords).
